one_liner: Consensus offers a self-serve REST API for scholarly paper search with a free tier (30 calls/month), API keys, OAuth 2.0 PKCE, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: API key generated self-serve in the API & MCP Dashboard (x-api-key header for REST; also accepted as a Bearer token on MCP). OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE (S256, scope search) with dynamic client registration issuing public clients; confidential clients provisioned manually via sales. API key kept primary since the main REST API documents it and OAuth scope is narrow.
access_notes: Docs say the API is self-serve and open to everyone; Free plan includes 30 calls/month (max 10 papers per call per the plans table, 1 req/s). Keys are created in the API & MCP Dashboard under Keys and Clients.
blocker_notes: Free tier is limited (30 calls/month, 1 req/s) but sufficient to build and test.

evidence.quote: Every request must include your API key in the `x-api-key` header:
Authorization-code flow only. There is no client-credentials grant, so OAuth always involves a per-user consent step; each user signs in to their own Consensus account.
It’s self-serve and open to everyone.
To get a key, click your profile icon in Consensus, choose **API & MCP Dashboard**, open **Keys and Clients**, and click **New key**.
One hosted server covers every field of science
claude mcp add --transport http consensus https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp
